info.title: Zoho CRM Audit Log Export
info.description: Read-only CRM audit-log export workflow for Microsoft Copilot Studio. Pass the user's natural-language question in the question field. The backend resolves the time range, action, module, user, and pagination automatically.
info.x-copilot-studio-tool-description: This tool retrieves Zoho CRM audit history. When a user asks about record updates, creations, deletions, audit history, or changes during a date range, invoke this tool. Infer the operation, date range, action, module, and user from the user's question. Do not ask the user to supply technical parameters. Use audit_log as the default operation. Use a default page size and offset when omitted. Do not use this tool for ordinary CRM calls, meetings, or tasks.

post.summary: Get CRM audit logs from a natural-language request
post.description: Returns Zoho CRM audit events. Pass the user's question in request.question. The backend infers the date range, action, module, user, and pagination. All structured parameters are optional and should only be provided when explicit overrides are needed.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Audit-log request. Pass the user's natural-language question in request.question. All other fields are optional and inferred by the backend.

400.description: Invalid audit-log request or date range.

403.description: Access denied or the configured Zoho identity cannot read audit logs.

413.description: Request body exceeds the configured size limit.

502.description: Upstream Zoho audit-log export or download failure.

AuditLogRequestBody.description: Pass the user's question in the question field. The backend infers operation, time_range, filters, and pagination from the question. All structured fields are optional overrides.

question.description: The user's natural-language audit-log question. The backend infers the date range, action, module, user, and pagination from this text. Examples: 'Show all CRM records updated on 25 September 2026', 'Who changed deals yesterday?', 'Show deleted records from the last seven days'.
x-copilot-studio-usage-hints: Show all CRM records updated yesterday
Show deleted CRM records from the last seven days
Give me all updates made on 25 September 2026
Show changes made by Kumar last month
Give me the audit history for this deal
Show all records created this week

operation.description: Defaults to audit_log. Do not ask the user for this value.

TimeRange.description: Optional. The backend resolves dates from the question when omitted.

start.description: Inclusive start. Inferred from the question when omitted.

end.description: Inclusive end. Inferred from the question when omitted.

AuditLogFilters.description: Optional. Inferred from the question when omitted.

action.description: Action filters. Inferred from the question when omitted.

module.description: CRM module filters. Inferred from the question when omitted.

done_by.description: User name filters. Inferred from the question when omitted.

PaginationRequest.description: Optional. Defaults to limit 20, offset 0 when omitted.

question.description: The original question that was processed.

display_columns.description: Column headers for table display: Date & Time, Action, Module, Record, Changed By, Details.

answer.description: Human-readable summary of the audit log results.
